title: Marburg virus disease – Rwanda
summary: It has been over a month since the declaration of the Marburg virus disease (MVD) outbreak in Rwanda on 27 September 2024.  As of 31 October 2024, 66 confirmed cases, including 15 deaths (CFR: 23%), have been reported including two new confirmed cases since the previous Disease Outbreak News report.
